question: Rajiv Kumar assumed charge as the _____ Chief Election Commissioner of India in May 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is **25th**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• Rajiv Kumar is appointed as the Chief Election Commissioner of the Election Commission of India (ECI) with effect from the 15th of May 2022.
 
• He will take up the post after incumbent Chief Election Commissioner Sushil Chandra demits his office on May 14, 2022.
 
• He has been an Election Commissioner of the ECI since September 1, 2020.
 
• He also served as Chairman of the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) in April 2020.
 
• The appointment is done by the President of India Ram Nath Kovind in pursuance of clause (2) of article 324 of the Constitution, as per a notification dated May 12, issued by the Law Ministry.
 
• He has been Director, of the Central Board of Reserve Bank of India (RBI), SBI, NABARD; a Member of, the Economic Intelligence Council (EIC); a Member of the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC); Member, of Bank Board Bureau (BBB); Member and other such Boards and Committees.
 
• Kumar was born on February 19, 1960, and has academic degrees in B.SC, LL.B, PGDM, and MA Public Policy.
 
• An officer of the Indian Administrative Service of Bihar/Jharkhand cadre 1984 batch, Kumar superannuated from the IAS in February 2020.
